title: Exact additive functors commute with good truncations and their canonical arrows
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories and F:A→B an additive functor preserving finite limits and finite colimits. For arbitrary integers p,q there are natural isomorphisms τ≤q followed by F ≅ F followed by τ≤q and τ≥p followed by F ≅ F followed by τ≥p. The first carries the canonical upper inclusion to F of that inclusion; F of the lower projection followed by the second is the canonical lower projection. These are functor isomorphisms on all unbounded cochain complexes. Good truncations mean [def-kun-truncations].

proof.text: Construct the lower comparison using identity above p, the preserved-cokernel comparison at p and zero objects below p. The cokernel universal property proves the chain equations, naturality and the lower projection identity. The inverse kernel and cokernel comparisons give inverses in every degree, hence natural isomorphisms. No relation between p and q is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem exactFunctorGoodTruncations {A : Type a} [Category.{b} A] [Abelian A]
    {B : Type c} [Category.{d} B] [Abelian B] (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (p q : ℤ) :
  ∃ (e : (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntLE q).truncLEFunctor A ⋙
        F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅ F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
          (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntLE q).truncLEFunctor B)
    (f : (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE p).truncGEFunctor A ⋙
        F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅ F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
          (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE p).truncGEFunctor B),
    (∀ K : CochainComplex A ℤ,
      e.hom.app K ≫ CochainComplex.ιTruncLE
          ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) q =
        (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (K.ιTruncLE q)) ∧
    (∀ K : CochainComplex A ℤ,
      (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (K.πTruncGE p) ≫ f.hom.app K =
        CochainComplex.πTruncGE ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) p)
